`4K/Vitruvian_Face_Height_Utility - Raw.exr` (float32 scan-derived face height; sha256 `37a58404b3c66689a2790a263d3a870797ff54438b6743f398d32464c466331e`) stored outside git at `/Volumes/files/openclinxr-assets/store/vitruvian-src/4K/`; shipped derivative `.openclinxr/openclaw/ceo/st-vitbody2/tile/reference-face-tile.png` (256x256 tangent normal; byte-identical to the original st-vitpore derivative; sha256 `0d7f18ff1c6d8129b1f919e9ee0832fcf15e2d7b2a77df803e67c449d99faa5d`). No Vitruvian UVs or HumanShaders/VitruvianGodot PNGs are consumed.

`vitruvian_pore_tile.py` takes a topology-free cheek crop, high-passes and wrap-blends it into a tangent-normal tile; `materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py:patch_glb_skin_shade` embeds one copy in Aisha's GLB and references it from both `OPENCLINXR_skin_shade.detailNormalTexture` (scale 90) and `bodyDetailNormalTexture` (scale 128, stochastic hex sampling).
**Keep.** CC0 is the cleanest posture. Re-run the deterministic tile station from the sha-pinned EXR if the derivative moves; replace only on measured texture-quality grounds.
